Order 
Dated this the 28th day of November, 2025 This is a petition filed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S., by the accused in Crime No.366/2016 of Rajakkad police station, Idukki, which is pending as C.C.
No.567/2016 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court (Munsiff Magistrate Court) Adimali.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court (Munsiff Magistrate Court) Adimali
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 498A and 34 of IPC.

2. The prosecution case is that the 1st accused being the husband of the defacto complainant and the 2nd accused being his relative subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally and thereby they are alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, in the mediation held at mediation sub centre Nedumkandam in M.C.No.33/2017, all the disputes between the parties were settled and as per the terms of the said mediation settlement, a sum of Rs.10 lakhs was paid by the 1 st petitioner to the defacto complainant and both parties agreed to put an end to all the pending cases between them.
According to the learned counsel after receiving the amount, the defacto complainant has retracted from the mediation 2025:KER:92021 CRL.M.C.NO.10168 OF 2025 agreement.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing the proceedings against the petitioners.
4. On a perusal of the mediation agreement dated 18.08.2025, it can be seen that, both parties have amicably settled all the disputes between them.

From Annexure 4 receipt produced by the petitioners, it is revealed that the 1 st petitioner has already paid a sum of Rs.10 lakhs to the defacto complainant as agreed in the memorandum of settlement.
In the above circumstances, withdrawal of the defacto complainant from the memorandum of agreement will not make any difference and as such this Crl.M.C. is liable to be allowed.
In the result, This Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.
No.567/2016 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court (Munsiff Magistrate Court) Adimali,
arising from Crime No.366/2016 of Rajakkad police station, Idukki, is quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. Sd/-
 C. PRATHEEP KUMAR,
